name: Grounded movement profile: lower jump, momentum, landing recovery
body: A per-level feel (the spawn's `movement` property) with a lower jump, a slower walk, a ramp up to speed and a short recovery after a hard landing. Existing levels keep the platformer feel because their gaps need it.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the six rooms and the crossing: the game feels like an action adventure (grounded movement, challenge from places and small games), not a puzzle platformer.

acceptance_criteria: A level whose spawn says movement is grounded uses the grounded constants
